description.value: A prospective cohort study of patients with behavioral-variant frontotemporal dementia examining whether MRI atrophy predicts survival and 3-year prognosis.

spans.text: To assess the clinical course and prognosis in patients with behavioral-variant frontotemporal dementia (FTD) lacking evidence of brain atrophy on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

value: We hypothesized that patients fulfilling clinical criteria for bvFTD but lacking evidence of frontotemporal atrophy on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) would have prolonged survival.
